caption: The drawing depicts three distinct objects: one brooch and two earrings, all rendered in shades of gold and silver with a highly detailed, textured appearance. The upper left section of the image shows the brooch from the front, designed in the shape of a small lyre or harp, with gold structural elements and finely meshed, silver-toned decorative components, including six oval-shaped drops hanging within the lyre frame. Adjacent to this, in the upper right, a side view of the brooch reveals its three-dimensional construction, with the gold framework and the same mesh drops visible in profile. In the lower half of the image, two earrings are shown: the left earring is depicted hanging freely, composed of a gold leaf ornament at the top and several elongated, textured silver drops suspended beneath, arranged in tiers, while the right earring displays a similar design but from a slightly different angle, showing the gold ear hook and an offset arrangement of the drops. The background is a plain, pale cream color with minimal shading, and the artist's signature "JOHN. H. TERGUZZI." is inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Brooch and Earrings
